title: WPMS/2763/2015 of Km Parul Jaiswal minor Vs Board Of School Education Uttarakhand

paras.text:
WPMS No. 2763 of 2015
U.C. Dhyani, J. Mr. K.S. Bora, Advocate for the petitioner.
Ms. Shivangi Gangwar, Advocate for the
respondent.
By means of present writ petition, the
petitioner seeks writ of mandamus directing the
respondent to recheck the answer sheet / answer
book of the subject English of Intermediate
Examination, 2015, of the petitioner and allot /
allocate appropriate marks.
Learned counsel for the respondent submits
that answer sheets of English paper of the
petitioner shall be got examined by the subject
expert and thereafter, fresh and correct mark-sheet
shall be issued as per marks awarded by the
subject expert in the subject within four weeks
from today. Order accordingly.
The writ petition thus stands disposed of.
